title: Women's Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) Research Study
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine the relationship between trauma and startle. The investigators are also looking at the effect of menstrual phase on this relationship.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women, ages 18-55 years old who have a regular menstrual cycle and who can come in to participate in the afternoon

Exclusion Criteria:

* Long-term medications, oral or steroid contraceptives, irregular menstrual cycle
